scope: Teks artikel ensiklopedis Indonesia namespace utama dari dump bertanggal dan lima teks undang-undang Indonesia yang sudah dihimpun; teks saja, tanpa media.

wikipedia_text.license_id: CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL for original Wikimedia text where applicable; some imported content may be CC BY-SA-only or have extra terms.
wikipedia_text.attribution_rule: URL to article/history or stable attributed copy, or author list; preserve import notices and additional attribution. Modified/redistributed text must carry compatible license notice and indicate changes.
wikipedia_text.limitations: Wikimedia says dumps may contain unrecognized copyright infringements and fair-use exceptions. Explicit rights-warning templates are excluded, but each page's import history and exceptions are not exhaustively reviewed. Model/weights implications require legal review.

indonesian_laws.license_id: Public domain under Indonesian Copyright Law No. 28/2014 Article 42(b), statutory text only.
indonesian_laws.limitations: Does not cover PDF layout, images, abstracts, commentary or all government-site content; source audit is in the original legal corpus inventory.

licenses.combined_collection: Per-document rights apply as listed below. CC BY-SA obligations apply to the Wikipedia text and modified text/data portions; the legal statute text remains public-domain under the stated Indonesian-law basis. Do not infer that trained weights have a settled license status.

text_filters: at least two substantial prose paragraphs
at least 100 words and five sentences
selection_policy.sampling: Deterministic BLAKE2b priority by page ID with seed 42; bounded to 20000 Wikipedia articles and 100000000 character-tokens.
selection_policy.deduplication: Exact SHA-256 after normalization, then word 5-gram SimHash (64-bit, Hamming <=3, length ratio >=0.80).
selection_policy.split: Document-level, after deduplication, seed 42; proportions train=0.98, validation=0.01, test=0.01. Each article remains one record; an article does not cross splits.
excluded_sources: SIBI textbooks pending explicit text/model-training rights
Project Gutenberg Indonesian catalog showed zero entries tagged id in the source audit
Tatoeba isolated sentences excluded from the prose core
Wikisource/Wikibooks omitted from this snapshot pending per-work license and text-quality review
all non-main namespaces, media, raw metadata, and non-prose page structures
